decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The premises shall be used for a restaurant and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 6 - The scheme approved under conditions 4 (sound insulation) and 5 (control of fumes - details) shall be fully implemented before the (A3 use, specified use, restaurant) opens to customers.
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 9.00am to 10.30pm weekdays (Monday-Friday) and Saturday, and 11.00am to 10.30pm on Sundays.
Condition : 8 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 9.00am-midday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 9 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
Condition : 10 - The rear door to the single-storey rear extension hereby approved shall be self-closing.

Condition : 11 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the mechanical ventilation of the toilets of the premises has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the scheme as approved fully implemented.
Condition : 13 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the premises outside the following times: 12midday to 10.00pm weekdays (Monday-Friday), Saturdays and Sundays.
Condition : 14 - The use shall not commence before the new shopfront and ramp up are completed.

Condition : 15 - 

Notwithstanding Condition 2, detailed drawings of the new shopfront shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
Condition : 16 - The use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises, and shall not extend to the delivery of food or drink to customers by vehicle.
description: Demolition of existing single storey rear extensions.  Erection of single storey rear extension incorporating 3 X rooflights, ventilation and noise control system and change of takeaway to restaurant use.  (Amended description - 01/11/2005)
